tools.name: vadyu_generate_video_ad
tools.description: Generate a commercial multi-cut AI video ad (with precision product cutout, live-action 3D studio lighting, golden-hour lifestyle scene, and AI studio voiceover) from a product_url, image_url, image_base64, or 0-credit reuse_video_id.

tools.name: vadyu_get_video_status
tools.description: Check render progress, video download URL, and share page URL for a Vadyu video ID.

tools.name: vadyu_preview_storefront
tools.description: Public zero-credit preview: extract up to 4 hero product packshots, recommended Vadyu 2.0 commercial ad style, and a 1-click preloaded Studio URL from any Shopify or DTC store URL (no API key required).

tools.name: vadyu_list_recipes
tools.description: List all 20 curated Vadyu 2.0 Commercial Ad Styles, 16 campaign funnels, and 9 audio moods.

tools.name: vadyu_list_sequences_and_formats
tools.description: List supported commercial aspect ratios (9:16, 4:5, 1:1, 16:9) and ad styles.

tools.name: vadyu_get_account_quota
tools.description: Check remaining video quota and subscription/pack plan.

tools.name: vadyu_list_videos
tools.description: List recent generated video ads on the authenticated account.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: vadyu_get_video_status · Private data: vadyu_preview_storefront · Public sink: vadyu_get_video_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: vadyu_get_video_status · Private data: vadyu_preview_storefront · Public sink: vadyu_get_video_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
